description: Independent, unseen evaluation dataset for the Barangay 183 Sentinel AI Chatbot. Contains no exact duplicates of the 188 training patterns in intents.json. Includes English, Tagalog, and Taglish queries across supported intents, ambiguous queries, and out-of-scope queries.

metadata.purpose: Academic Model Validation for Capstone Priority #8
